card.name: Copyright and reuse notices on websites
card.fires_on: Small opening or linking words in web copyright and permission notices, such as Use, All, For, any, may, and except. It fires right after a copyright or image-rights sentence.

modes.label: Start of a rights sentence
modes.description: The first word of a new sentence following a copyright statement, such as All or Use.
modes.example: © 1995-2013 by Michael W. Davidson and The Florida State University.<< All>> Rights Reserved. No images, graphics,

modes.label: Linking word inside permission terms
modes.description: A short word inside a clause about reproducing or reusing material.
modes.example: No part of this excerpt may be reproduced<< except>> with permission in writing from the publisher.

card.writes: It suppresses legal-notice words like NONINFRINGEMENT, COPYING, redistribute and GPL, so it dampens a license or legalese continuation.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a website's copyright or image-reuse notice where the next word would continue the legal wording.
